tasks.description: Comprehensive verification of the Trailblaze Auto platform, covering public car inventory browsing and secure administrative management systems.
acceptance_criteria: Home Page Loading and Branding. The application landing page must load successfully, displaying the main branding message 'Drive Your Dream' and a navigation bar with a link to 'Inventory'.
Inventory Navigation and Listing. Selecting the 'Inventory' link redirects the user to the /browse page, which fetches and displays a gallery of vehicle cards with Name, Brand, and Price.

Vehicle Detail Visibility. Clicking on a specific vehicle card in the public gallery navigates the user to the /car/:id page, showing detailed specifications including Transmission, Fuel Type, and Mileage.

Administrator Authentication. Entering valid admin credentials on the /admin login page successfully authenticates the session and redirects to the /admin/dashboard with a 'Login successful' notification.
Admin Dashboard Overview. The /admin/dashboard page must display global statistics (Total Cars) and a recent activities log to provide high-level oversight of the fleet.

Registering New Fleet Vehicles. The multi-step 'Add New Vehicle' interface allows administrators to input basic info, specifications, and media, persisting the new car to the database upon submission.
Editing Existing Car Data. The 'Edit Car' feature allows administrators to modify any property of an existing vehicle record, with updates reflecting immediately across both public and admin views.
Admin Profile and Account Details. The /admin/profile page displays the current administrator's account information, confirming the identity of the logged-in user.
Login Attempt with Invalid Credentials. Entering an incorrect email or password on the /admin login page displays a 'validation error' notification and prevents access to the dashboard.
Form Validation for Mandatory Fields. Attempting to progress through or submit the 'Add New Vehicle' wizard without filling in required fields (like Brand or Name) prevents the operation.

Route Protection for Unauthenticated Access. Users attempting to manually navigate to protected routes like /admin/dashboard or /admin/inventory without an active session are redirected to the login page.
Image Link Fallback Handling. Providing an invalid or unreachable image URL in the 'Vehicle Media' step of the Add/Edit form correctly handles the error state in the preview thumbnail.
